mapper.select: SELECT F.FAVORITE_IDX AS favoriteIdx, F.ADMIN_DONG_CODE AS adminDongCode, A.ADMIN_DONG_NAME AS adminDongName, D.DISTRICT_NAME AS districtName, F.INITIAL_CAPITAL AS initialCapital, F.SERVICE_CATEGORY_NAME AS serviceCategoryName, F.REG_DATE AS regDate FROM FAVORITE_LIST F JOIN AREA_ADMIN_DONG A ON F.ADMIN_DONG_CODE = A.ADMIN_DONG_CODE JOIN AREA_DISTRICT D ON LEFT(CAST(F.ADMIN_DONG_CODE AS CHAR), 5) = CAST(D.DISTRICT_CODE AS CHAR) WHERE F.USER_IDX = #{userIdx} ORDER BY F.REG_DATE DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FAVORITE_LIST (ADMIN_DONG_CODE, USER_IDX, INITIAL_CAPITAL, SERVICE_CATEGORY_NAME) VALUES (#{adminDongCode}, #{userIdx}, #{initialCapital}, #{serviceCategoryName})
